text: [angry, fast] You can't build round a man who won't sign. Sell Bruno!
One league win in ten, and Pochettino starts at Anfield. One question. Bruno... sell him, or build round him?
[passionate, raised voice] Sell him? Twenty-one assists last season! He's the only one out there who wants the ball.
[laughing in disbelief] Number one in March, eleventh now. Ha! Even my Wi-Fi doesn't drop that fast.
[tired, quiet] We should've sold him last summer. [sighs] Wait any longer and we get nothing back.
[calm, firm] Neither. He's waiting to see if Poch is any good. So should we. Decide in the summer.
Sell, keep or loan? On ACTXION, Transfer Window lets you decide who United buy, sell, keep or loan.
Sell him, or build round him? You tell us.
